artifact_inventory.description: Exact-integer verification of the Möbius-inversion column transform and Vandermonde determinant for representative characters.
Deterministic output of the exact-integer replay.

limitations: The Takloo-Bighash full text was inaccessible in this run, leaving source-version risk for the exact constant in its quoted remainder bound.; Unindexed concurrent work on the September 2026 preprint could overlap.; The result remains below the conjectural linear-size family and does not claim the constant is optimal.
record_title: Square-root Rankin-Cohen independence for quadratic twists
scientific_context: For fixed odd fundamental discriminant \(D\), the theorem upgrades growing-block independence to a true square-root scale by an exact Möbius-inversion preconditioning of the Fourier endpoint matrix.
